violations.detail: Pin U6.RF_OUT_2 is connected to 2 distinct nets — RF_OUT_2_U6, TERM_U6_RF_OUT_2 — types: analog, signal. A single pin is one electrical node, so these nets are shorted together. If this is a differential pair (_P/_N) tied to one off-page connector pin, give each polarity its own connector pin.
Power/ground rail 'VCC' has 22 endpoints but none of the reference designators look like a driver (PWR*, REG*, LDO*, CONN*). Verify a supply source is actually connected.
